verdict.rationale: OpenClaw has no dedicated bulk-operations feature. It can still fan work out across many items: Swarm orchestrates many sub-agents from Code Mode scripts using Promise.all, with bounded fan-out and structured results. Sub-agents run long or slow work in parallel, and the mutating exec shell can act on many files at once. Missing for 10: a first-class bulk-action surface (e.g., multi-select or batch commands over items), documented examples of batch operations on channel or messaging items, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
